title: HF3846 (2019-2020 Regular): Firearms; Saturday night special handgun ban repealed.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/91/2020/0/HF/3846/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced (undated in the text file); no votes. Section 1 strikes the words 'and the regulation of Saturday night special pistols' and changes the cross-reference from 624.716 to 624.7162. The repealed sections (appendix, not quoted as law) are the definition of 'Saturday night special pistol' and the gross-misdemeanor offence for a licensed dealer who sells one or a person who makes or assembles one.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.717): Sections 624.711 to 624.7162 shall be construed to supersede municipal or county regulation of the carrying or possessing of pistols.
Sec. 2 (repealer): Minnesota Statutes 2018, sections 624.712, subdivision 4; and 624.716, are repealed.
